key.name: expanded
key.description: Whether the application volume section is expanded in Quick Settings. The state is remembered across sessions.

key.name: show-input-streams
key.description: Also list applications that are recording audio, so their input volume can be adjusted independently.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the current volume of every application as a percentage next to its name.

key.name: show-media-name
key.description: Append the description reported by the audio stream (usually the media title) to the application name.

key.name: hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide when no application plays audio
key.description: Remove the section from Quick Settings entirely while no application is using the audio stack, instead of showing a placeholder.

key.name: max-visible-apps
key.description: Limit how many applications are listed at once to keep Quick Settings compact. Set to 0 for no limit.

key.name: remember-volumes
key.description: Restore the last volume and mute state of an application when it starts playing audio again. Leave this off when the audio server already restores per-application volumes (the default with both PipeWire and PulseAudio).

key.name: app-volumes
key.description: Maps an application identifier to its last known volume (as a fraction of the normal maximum volume) and mute state.
